query: Before I sign, I want to check that the routeXdr I got back really enforces the minimum output the quote promised. How do I inspect it?
expected_behavior: Use verifyStellarRouteBytes(routeXdr, { tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, minOut }) or mapQuoteResponseToStrategySwap with caller-owned expected values.
Take pair, input, and accepted minimum from request state. Do not copy expectations only from response JSON.
Use the published SDK decoder for route inspection. Do not copy an application decoder.
Build the standalone invocation locally with trusted router, caller, and current source sequence. Prepare it and check assertStellarPreparedTxAuth against builtXdr.
Do not transfer or approve tokens to the router beforehand. The router pulls input under the sender authorization.
Simulate the complete transaction. Route verification does not prove liquidity, venue behavior, or budget feasibility.
Pass caller-owned pair, input, and accepted output floor to the SDK route mapper expected option.
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js@1.0.228 and @stellar/stellar-sdk@16.
Source imports the SDK route verifier or mapper.
Source contains no custom ScVal route decoder.
